title: SREV-026 LoadKey path wire size

unicode_string_shape.description: UNICODE_STRING.Length and MaximumLength are byte counts for a Unicode buffer; native registry/file object paths are counted Unicode strings at the OS boundary

wire_layout.description: FILE_LOAD_KEY_REQ carries KeyPath (registry key path to mount) and FilePath (hive file path) both sized FILE_LOAD_KEY_PATH_CHARS = 1024 WCHARs

shared_capacity_constant.description: FILE_LOAD_KEY_PATH_CHARS names the wire capacity once; both Key_NtLoadKeyImpl sender and the SbieSvc receiver enforce that capacity

sender_gate.description: Sender checks wcslen(path) < FILE_LOAD_KEY_PATH_CHARS before copy; oversized paths fail closed before SbieDll_CallServer

receiver_gate.description: Receiver terminates using FILE_LOAD_KEY_PATH_CHARS - 1 instead of hard-coded 127

runtime_matrix.description: Windows runtime gate: TrustedInstaller COMPONENTS/SCHEMA hive load works; long Windows directory paths below 1024 WCHARs reach service allowlist; paths >= FILE_LOAD_KEY_PATH_CHARS fail closed; malformed messages still fail closed

contracts: LoadKey request path capacity is declared once via FILE_LOAD_KEY_PATH_CHARS
Sender rejects paths whose length reaches the wire capacity before any wcscpy
Receiver uses FILE_LOAD_KEY_PATH_CHARS - 1 for the terminator slot
128-WCHAR limit was a Sandboxie service-wire limit, not an OS limit
